adjudication.rationale: The retested build passes with changes for the internal scope. The new parser derives speaker identity from visual direction and screenshot owner, discards recruiter-backed candidate assertions, preserves exact evidence and ambiguity, and the explicit versioned benchmark passes 136 of 136 atomic checks across ten forward and reverse live cases. The production browser retrieves the image-flow contact through server search, reopens 14 governed Wiki references, preserves two unresolved fields and No action, has no console errors, and has no mobile horizontal overflow. The explicit model benchmark therefore exceeds the user's 95 threshold at 100 percent. Specialist scores remain attached to separate 0–4 rubrics and are not averaged or converted into a decorative percentage: each remains 2 because independent human calibration, assistive and real-device evidence, an external-effect loop, and field-value evidence are still absent. Kimi did not run; the panel relies on an explicitly labeled Playwright fallback and does not conceal that limitation.
